text:
michelle: Quick FYI — hitting flaky 401s in the new Next.js starter that bundles a tiny LlamaIndex example. Happens during concurrent SSR requests (CONCURRENT=4). Repro: git clone, npm i, RW_API_KEY set, npm run dev, open 4 tabs and trigger a page that does generate+embed.

dan: Can you paste the server handler? Might be the minimal fetch shim we used.

michelle: yep — handler uses raw fetch to /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings with process.env.RW_API_KEY. No SDK usage to keep deps minimal. Snippet in the issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-next-starter/issues/66

anya: That pattern bypasses SDK refresh/retry/circuit-breaker helpers. With KMS rotation or bursty traffic you'll see transient 401s and occasional 502 from exhausted ephemeral workers.

michelle: I added logs: 401 on first concurrent attempts, then 200 on a retry. Sometimes the retry doesn't happen because we short-circuit on timeout in the shim.

dan: Two quick fixes: 1) Default server handlers in the sample to use @redwood/sdk-js clients (generate/embed) so they inherit retry semantics. 2) Keep an opt-in RAW_FETCH=true flag so educational minimal example remains possible.

anya: Also add a tiny CI eval test that simulates a rotation: return 401 for the first call and 200 for the second (msw). That will ensure SDK refresh behavior is exercised in the harness.

michelle: filed PR 12 with changes: switch server handlers to SDK by default, introduce REDWOOD_USE_RAW_FETCH env flag (default false), add msw-based rotation test, and a README note about SSR auth caveats. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-next-starter/pull/12

ci-bot: CI started for branch michelle/sdk-default (job 9002).

dan: One more onboarding tweak — update Quickstart troubleshooting: "If concurrent SSR calls sometimes return 401, try using the SDK-backed server handler or increase REDWOOD_SDK_RETRIES in staging."

anya: Nice. Long-term we should standardize retry semantics across SDKs (which statuses trigger refresh, max attempts, backoff). I'll create a short RFC for SDK parity.

michelle: CI passed and PR merged. Running 20 harness loops with CONCURRENT=5 shows no flakes on the SDK path. Closing issue after 24h. Thanks!
